record.title: Mehran prohibition on direct truck entry into Iraq, October 2019
record.scope: Direct entry of Iranian / transit trucks; transshipment remained permitted
record.direction: Truck entry from Iran into Iraq
record.movement: Trucks crossing into Iraq; goods transferred onto Iraqi trucks were treated separately
record.exceptions: Cargo delivery to Iraqi trucks at the Mehran terminal was expressly allowed.
record.imposing_authority: Iranian Ilam provincial and border authorities, as reported by deputy governor Nozari
record.enforcement: Provincial official reports a prohibition; subsequent customs interview distinguishes it from continued trade.
record.relationship: No duplicate of the early-October Khosravi/Chazzabeh pilgrimage restriction.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current closure status inferred.
record.official_rationale: Unrest in Iraq and safety conditions for cross-border travel.
record.context: A later phase of Iraqi protests triggered another Iranian frontier measure.
record.uncertainty: No reopening established. Passenger statements differ, so the record is limited to the consistently documented truck restriction. November 3 continuity is an indexed customs interview, not direct gate observation.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. A single uninterrupted closure duration is not supported for the combined categories and phases.
